Kill [[Mohby Windbeak]].

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Kill Mohby Windbeak in the [[Gyala Hatchery (explorable area)|Gyala Hatchery]].
* *BONUS* Kill Mohby Windbeak in [[Hard Mode]].
* See [[Zehnchu]] <nowiki>[</nowiki>[[Zaishen]] Challenge] for your reward.

===Reward===
* 1,000 [[Experience]]
* 500 [[Gold]]
* 500 [[Luxon faction|Luxon Faction]]
* Complete the Base Objective for 20 [[Copper Zaishen Coin]]s.
* Complete the *BONUS* Objective for an additional 50 Zaishen Copper Coins.

==Walkthrough==
Enter from [[Leviathan Pits]]. Go towards the gate where the [[Outcast]]s and [[Luxon]]s are fighting. You can try to slip by them while they fight, but in [[hard mode]] the Outcasts kill the Luxons quite quickly. After you pass the gate, take the left side of the fork and hug the hillside going northwest. Then go towards the massive jade wave - there are many north-south groups with overlapping patrol paths along the way that can be avoided, or farmed for reputation (approximately 60 enemies, including 4 bosses). Be aware of over-aggroing as new patrols arrive. From there you will be able to scout out the boss [[patrol]]ling along the jade. Try to [[pull]] foes away first as they may get [[aggro]]ed while you fight the boss.
